midi.title: MIDI
midi.hint: To map a controller, hold the MIDI key of the top bar until its ring is full, touch a fader or a key of the interface, then move or press the control of the controller. Press the MIDI key (or Escape) to leave. Mappings are saved in the show with the name of their device.
midi.clearDevice: Delete the mappings of the device
midi.mscHint: A show controller can drive the cue list of the console: Go (also to a cue number), Stop pauses, Resume goes on, Reset releases.
midi.profilesHint: A profile maps a common controller: you touch its controls one at a time, as asked (scenes and chasers go on their places, faders on masters and groups). Mackie Control is mapped at once. Places without a scene, chaser or group are left out.
midi.profileHint: Move or press the control on the controller. Skip goes to the next one.
midi.profileEmpty: The show has no scenes, chasers or groups for this profile yet.
midi.mtcHint: The loaded timeline follows a MIDI timecode (MTC) of another machine or a DAW: it plays from the same point while the timecode runs and pauses when it stops. The start is the timecode at the start of the timeline.
